content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Nagpur Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur is an autonomous institute of national importance established under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY) by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India. The Institute has issued notification number AIIMS/NGP/Guest Faculty/2026/12/2986 dated 22/10/2026 for the empanelment of Guest Faculty for the College of Nursing. The selected faculty members will handle specific academic hours during the current academic session on a clock-hour remuneration basis.

rows.experience: Minimum of 03 years collegiate/university level teaching experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Guest Faculty members will receive a remuneration of Rs. 1,000/- per class/per hour. The maximum hours during the academic session are capped at 60 hours for Computer Applications, 45 hours for Health & Nursing Information Technology, and 60 hours for Sociology & Applied Sociology. The Executive Director, AIIMS, Nagpur reserves the right to hire the services of Guest Faculty for the current as well as the next Academic Year, depending upon performance, purely on a clock-hour basis.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The mode of selection will be based on the performance of the Interview only. However, the Institute reserves the right to hold a Screening Test or any other screening process to shortlist candidates to be called for interview in posts against which a larger number of eligible candidates apply. The decision of the Institute regarding selection will be final.

rows.details: Prescribed pro forma for Guest Faculty application

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are 3 subject allocations advertised: Computer Applications (60 hours), Health & Nursing Information Technology (45 hours), and Sociology & Applied Sociology (60 hours).

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 55 years as on 1st January 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the remuneration provided to Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Guest Faculty members are paid Rs. 1,000/- per class/per hour up to the maximum specified hours during the academic session.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline in the prescribed pro forma via speed post or Registered A.D. to AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of application in AIIMS, Nagpur is 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement (approximately 21 November 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: Selection is based on interview performance, though the Institute may conduct a screening test or screening process if a large number of applications are received.

faq.question: Q7. Can the engagement be extended for the next academic year?
faq.answer: Yes, the Executive Director, AIIMS, Nagpur reserves the right to hire the services of Guest Faculty for the current as well as the next Academic Year based on performance, purely on a clock hour basis.
